It is suitable for IP surveillance systems, enterprise networks, retail environments, hotels, hospitals, schools, factories, warehouses, offices, and smart building installations.

Its compact, plug-and-play design requires no software configuration or technical expertise, allowing quick installation and immediate deployment. Simply connect compatible devices, and the switch automatically handles power delivery and network communication.

name: ZEBRONICS 5MP HD Dome Camera with Color Night Vision SD602-AHDPDSL24
short_description:
Secure your home or business with the ZEBRONICS SD602-AHDPDSL24 5MP HD Dome Camera. Featuring 5MP Ultra HD resolution, Color Night Vision, 4 Warm White LEDs, CMOS Image Sensor, Weatherproof housing, Low Illumination performance, and support for AHD, CVI, TVI & CVBS, this dome camera delivers sharp, reliable surveillance for indoor and outdoor security applications.

Key Features

  • 5MP Ultra HD Resolution
  • Color Night Vision
  • 4 Warm White LEDs
  • CMOS Image Sensor
  • AHD/CVI/TVI/CVBS Compatible
  • Weatherproof Dome Design
description:
The ZEBRONICS SD602-AHDPDSL24 5MP HD Dome Camera is a premium analog HD surveillance solution designed to provide outstanding image quality and dependable monitoring for residential, commercial, and industrial security installations. Combining 5MP Ultra HD resolution, intelligent image enhancement technologies, and Color Night Vision, this camera ensures clear and detailed surveillance throughout the day and night.

Powered by a high-performance 5MP CMOS Image Sensor, the SD602-AHDPDSL24 captures highly detailed video that allows accurate identification of people, vehicles, and important events. The superior resolution offers significantly greater clarity than conventional Full HD cameras, making it suitable for entrances, reception areas, offices, retail stores, warehouses, educational institutions, apartment buildings, hospitals, hotels, and commercial premises.

One of the major highlights of this camera is its Color Night Vision capability. Equipped with 4 Warm White LEDs, the camera produces vivid full-color images during nighttime instead of conventional black-and-white infrared footage. Color surveillance improves scene recognition by preserving important details such as clothing colors, vehicle colors, and surrounding objects, making recorded footage more useful for security investigations.

The advanced CMOS Image Sensor delivers excellent image quality while maintaining strong performance in challenging lighting conditions. Thanks to its Low Illumination capability, the camera produces brighter, cleaner, and more detailed images even in dimly lit environments.

To further enhance image quality, the SD602-AHDPDSL24 incorporates multiple intelligent image processing technologies:

  • ICR (Infrared Cut Filter Removal) enables automatic switching between day and night modes for consistent image quality.
  • AGC (Automatic Gain Control) improves brightness in low-light environments.
  • AWB (Auto White Balance) delivers accurate and natural color reproduction.
  • BLC (Back Light Compensation) improves visibility when strong light sources are positioned behind the subject.
  • HLC (Highlight Compensation) minimizes glare from headlights and other intense light sources.
  • WDR / DWDR (Wide Dynamic Range) balances exposure in scenes containing both bright and dark areas.
  • DNR (Digital Noise Reduction) reduces image noise to produce cleaner and sharper video.

The camera also supports UTC (Up The Coax) technology, allowing installers to conveniently adjust camera settings directly through the DVR without accessing the camera physically, simplifying maintenance and installation.

Designed for maximum compatibility, the SD602-AHDPDSL24 supports AHD, CVI, TVI, and CVBS video formats. This multi-format capability enables seamless integration with most modern HD DVRs and many existing analog CCTV systems, making it an excellent option for both new installations and surveillance upgrades.

Its weatherproof dome housing is built to withstand dust, rain, and varying environmental conditions, making it suitable for both indoor and outdoor installations. The compact dome design offers discreet surveillance while protecting the camera from tampering and environmental exposure.

Whether installed in homes, offices, retail stores, schools, hospitals, restaurants, hotels, warehouses, factories, or apartment complexes, the ZEBRONICS SD602-AHDPDSL24 delivers dependable security with superior image quality and reliable day-and-night monitoring.
